explanation: For the upper surface g=5−x²−y², the outward vector area element is ⟨2x,2y,1⟩ dA. Its flux integrand is −2xg+x. The downward-facing bottom disk contributes −x, leaving −2x(5−x²−y²)=2x³+2xy²−10x, option e. All displayed choices integrate to zero by symmetry, but e is the directly derived integrand.
